name: Chirag Mathur
summary: Software Engineer with 4 years of experience building full-stack applications, AI-powered automation systems, and scalable business solutions.

highlights: Built a centralized ERP system in Google Apps Script, replacing manual Excel operations with an integrated order-to-delivery workflow covering sales, production, packing, dispatch, invoicing, and payment tracking.

Engineered an end-to-end invoice-to-payment automation platform with Python, FastAPI, Next.js, and PostgreSQL: AI-assisted bill extraction, multi-level approvals, Tally entries, bank payment files, and automatic reconciliation.
Implemented role-based access control, audit workflows, OTP-protected approvals, and payment prioritization for centralized visibility across departments.
Automated daily Petpooja-to-Tally sales reconciliation across 7 outlets, cutting processing effort to about 10% of the previous two-person manual workflow.
Automated salary and cash voucher accounting, compliance renewals, Zomato/Swiggy report consolidation, and bill retrieval from Tally.
Built a real-time AI hiring and interview platform with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, integrating ElevenLabs, Sarvam AI, and Tavus for voice- and avatar-based interviews.
Developed a Gemini-powered shortlisting system that scored resumes against job descriptions and generated relevant interview questions.
Built multilingual interview experiences in 19+ languages, with live transcripts, scorecards, recordings, and AI-generated evaluation reports.
Helped 5+ companies screen 6,000+ resumes and conduct 581+ AI interviews; improved performance with code-splitting, lazy loading, and optimized state management.
Engineered scalable Node.js, Express.js, and TypeScript endpoints for high-throughput real-time integrations.
Integrated an AI-powered natural language search service with Next.js, OpenAI API, and SerpAPI, reducing latency by 80%.
Optimized MongoDB schemas and queries for a system handling 250+ concurrent users.
Founded a software development agency, building secure full-stack architectures and backend services for 14+ client projects.
Developed e-commerce platforms including Kalodoro and SCNutrition, backed by Node.js APIs and relational/non-relational databases, serving 37K+ monthly visitors.
Implemented secure payment processing, third-party API integrations, and role-based access control with JWT/OAuth.
Automated deployment and version control pipelines using Git, GitHub, and cloud platforms, maintaining 99.9% system uptime.
